problemBoundary: Complete the bootstrap-to-Stable-Core contract by resolving exact Delivery+Change coordination state and required activation provenance/dependencies from the existing durable Delivery manifest before status/next consume that state; keep Policy pure and do not create another state/control-plane subsystem.
durableFacts: The exact current D02 manifest records the corrective Change active, all four normal D02 quality Changes planned, and each quality Change hard-depending on the corrective Change.

The current CLI still accepts caller-supplied changeState and passes it directly to Policy; a caller can make the planned Gate report READY_ACTION(explore), while caller planned can make the durable-active corrective Change report BLOCKED(change-not-active).
D01 proof history explicitly treated the Delivery manifest as the durable place where Change activation state survives sessions/payload overlays.
The current D02 manifest contains one exact structural-valid activate-change OwnerAuthorityFact for the corrective Change; no new authority record type is needed.
No production source currently resolves openspec/delivery-groups or dependsOn, so the missing seam is before Policy rather than inside Policy.
Policy already remains pure/deterministic and should not gain filesystem, manifest, Git or Owner-decision IO.
status and next both currently depend on CommonRunRequest.changeState and therefore must share one trusted coordination-state resolver.
The accepted repository has no direct production YAML parser dependency; a hand-written parser, undeclared transitive import, managed-tool internal import, or second state store is not justified.
The four normal D02 quality Changes remain mutually independent after the corrective Change completes; only their shared hard dependency on the correction is frozen.
proposalDirection: Modify existing Foundation contracts primarily in foundation-cli-surface and lifecycle-authority-and-identity; avoid creating a new state subsystem capability unless Proposal proof requires it.
Resolve the exact Delivery manifest by repositoryRoot + DeliveryId and the exact single Change entry by ChangeId before status/next construct their outputs/Policy facts.

For durable active state, require matching structural-valid activate-change Owner authority with exact Delivery+Change identity and require all direct dependsOn targets to be completed; fail closed otherwise.

Remove caller changeState from the authority-bearing request surface if possible; if one bounded compatibility reason remains, retain it only as a fail-closed consistency assertion that cannot override durable truth.
Use one shared resolver for status and next; pass only the canonical resolved ChangeState to pure evaluatePolicyAndNextBoundary.

Use a declared minimal repository runtime YAML parser if implementation needs one; do not import transitive or managed-tool internals and do not create a new JSON coordination store merely to avoid YAML parsing.
Keep checkpoint Owner authority as a separate decision seam and do not generalize all Owner decisions into one switch.
